title: The branch format, version 1
description: A work item's branch and the commit in each repository: the file of a version of a structured artifact type branch.

ref.description: The branch's name, the same in each repository: qory/ followed by the work item's id.

repositories.description: Each repository with the commit of the branch in it, at least one.

system.description: The host the repository is on, such as github.com: a lower-case host name of at most 253 characters.

path.description: The repository's path on the host, such as acme/web: at most 200 characters of segments joined by slashes, with no ., .. or .git segment.

commit.description: A full commit id: 40 or 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.
